title: Modul POS - Void & Return - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap membatalkan order (void) dan mengembalikan item (return) di POS dengan approval workflow, stock reversal, payment refund, dan audit trail.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Void & Return adalah proses pembatalan order atau pengembalian item dengan proper workflow untuk maintain inventory accuracy dan financial integrity. Void untuk membatalkan order keseluruhan, Return untuk customer kembalikan beberapa item setelah order selesai.

items.title: Void Order - Overview
items.body: Void: Membatalkan seluruh order sebelum atau sesudah payment. When Applicable: - Customer berubah pikiran (before payment) - Order salah dibuat (cashier error) - Customer tidak jadi beli (out of stock saat confirm) - Order tidak sesuai (wrong item prepared) - Any reason untuk cancel entire order Order Status Dapat di-Void: - DRAFT: Not yet confirmed - CONFIRMED: Confirmed but not paid - PAID: Already paid Order Status TIDAK Bisa di-Void: - COMPLETED: Use RETURN instead - VOIDED: Already void

items.title: Void Order - Proses
items.body: Step 1: Open Order - Cashier/FoH find order (by order number atau table) - Click order detail - Display order info & status Step 2: Click 'Void Order' - Button visible (if order can be voided) - Dialog muncul: - Confirmation: "Void order #ORD-1001?" - Reason selection (required)*: - "Customer request" - "Wrong item prepared" - "Out of stock" - "Operator error" - "Other: [text input]" - Notes (optional): - Additional detail - Example: "Customer changed mind - no reason" Step 3: Validation - System check: - If void amount > threshold (Rp 50K): - Require manager approval - Show manager notification - If < threshold: Auto-approve (cashier can proceed) Step 4: Approval (if > threshold) - Manager receive notification - View order detail & void reason - Manager approve/reject: - APPROVE: Enter PIN, confirm - REJECT: Enter reason, cancel void - If manager approve: - Void proceed - System execute - If manager reject: - Void cancelled - Cashier get notification - Cashier can retry dengan lower amount atau different reason Step 5: System Execute Void - Update order status → VOIDED - Timestamp void recorded - Stock reversal (if paid/deducted): - STOCK mode: Add qty back - RECIPE mode: Add ingredients back - Payment reversal (if paid): - CASH: Show "Refund customer Rp XXX" (cashier return cash) - CARD: Auto-reverse transaction di EDC/bank (1-5 days) - QRIS: Auto-reverse to customer account (instant-same day) - Audit trail recorded: - Who void, when, why, amount - Approval (if applicable) Step 6: Completion - Success message: "Order voided successfully" - Display: - Refund amount (if cash): "Please refund customer Rp XXX" - Non-cash: "Refund will process in 1-5 days" - Order available di history (for audit) - Negative transaction recorded (financial reconciliation)

items.title: Void Refund by Payment Method
items.body: CASH Payment Void: - Original: Paid cash Rp 50.000 - Void executed - System show: "Please refund customer Rp 50.000" - Cashier: Take Rp 50.000 dari drawer, give ke customer - Customer receive cash immediately - Record: Refund amount, time, signature (if required) CARD Payment Void: - Original: Card payment Rp 50.000 - Void executed - System auto-reverse transaksi ke EDC/bank - Show: "Refund initiated. Processing in 1-5 business days" - Customer see credit/debit in account after processing - Reference # shown untuk customer verify - No immediate cash given QRIS Payment Void: - Original: QRIS Rp 50.000 - Void executed - System auto-reverse ke payment provider - Amount return ke customer's account (bank/e-wallet) - Usually instant atau same-day - Show: "Refund processing" - Customer check their account Multi-Payment Void: - Original: Cash Rp 30.000 + QRIS Rp 20.000 - Void executed - Proportional refund: - Cash: Cashier return Rp 30.000 - QRIS: Auto-reverse Rp 20.000 - Receipt show all refund detail

items.title: Return Item - Overview
items.body: Return: Customer sudah dapat order (COMPLETED) tapi ada item rusak/tidak sesuai. When Applicable: - Item damaged/broken - Item tidak sesuai dengan order - Makanan tidak enak - Item sudah expired - Any reason untuk return item Return Window: - Default: 24 jam setelah order completed - Configurable per outlet - After window: Cannot return (use complaint/compensation) Order Status Dapat di-Return: - COMPLETED: Order selesai & paid Item Bisa di-Return: - Any item dalam order - Partial return allowed (tidak harus semua) - Multiple item dapat di-return

items.title: Return Item - Proses
items.body: Step 1: Open Completed Order - Customer/FoH find order (usually with receipt) - Click order detail - Display: Order info, items, payment - Status: COMPLETED Step 2: Click 'Return Item' - Button available untuk completed order - Dialog muncul: - Item list (checkbox setiap item) - Quantity input (jika qty > 1) - Select items to return Step 3: Select Items & Quantity - Example: - Bakso × 2: Check 2 qty (return all) - Es Teh × 3: Check 1 qty (return 1, keep 2) - Gorengan × 1: Uncheck (keep, not return) - Display subtotal untuk returned items Step 4: Input Return Reason - Required field - Reason options: - "Damaged" - "Wrong preparation" - "Not as ordered" - "Expired/bad quality" - "Other: [text]" - Add detail notes (optional) Step 5: Manager Approval - Return always require manager approval (compliance) - System notify manager - Manager review: - Returned items & quantity - Return reason - Customer identity - Manager approve/reject - APPROVE: Return process - REJECT: Return denied, explain reason ke customer Step 6: Calculate Refund - System calculate refund amount: - Item price × qty returned - Minus proportional discount - Minus proportional tax - = Net refund - Example: - Bakso × 2 @ Rp 25K = Rp 50K - Return 1 Bakso = Rp 25K - Proportional discount: Rp 25K / Rp 70K (orig) × Rp 7K (discount) = Rp 2.5K - Proportional tax: Rp 25K / Rp 70K × Rp 7.7K (tax) = Rp 2.75K - Net refund: Rp 25K - Rp 2.5K + Rp 2.75K = Rp 25.25K (approx) - Simplified: Rp 25K (exact item price) Step 7: Process Refund - Same as void (by payment method): - CASH: Cashier return cash - CARD: Auto-reverse (1-5 days) - QRIS: Auto-reverse (instant) Step 8: Create Return Order - System create return record: - Linked ke original order - Return date & time - Items returned & quantity - Reason - Refund amount - Manager approval - Timestamp Step 9: Stock Reversal - Items returned to inventory: - STOCK mode: Add qty back - RECIPE mode: Add ingredients back - Stock transaction recorded - Inventory now accurate Step 10: Complete - Return processed - Refund issued - Receipt/proof given - Customer satisfied - Item: - Discard (bad quality) - Return ke supplier - Rework (if possible)

content.body: Recorded Info (for Void & Return): - Order ID & details - Void/Return type - Reason - Items & quantity (for return) - Original amount - Refund amount - Refund method - Cashier/operator name - Manager approval status & name - Timestamp - Additional notes Accessible To: - Admin (all) - Manager (outlet) - Finance (reconciliation) - Cashier (own void/return) Retention: - Keep minimum 7 years (tax compliance) - For audit & dispute resolution - Cannot delete void/return (immutable)

1. Void Rules: - Require manager approval if > threshold - Reason required - Stock reversal automatic - Payment reversal automatic - Timestamp immutable 2. Return Rules: - Only for COMPLETED order - Within return window (default 24 hrs) - Manager approval required (always) - Partial return allowed - Stock reversal automatic - Proportional refund calculation 3. Refund Rules: - Same method as original payment (when possible) - CASH: Immediate - CARD: 1-5 business days - QRIS: Instant-same day - Multi-payment: Proportional

items.title: Q: Cannot void - Manager approval timeout
items.body:
A: Manager tidak respond dalam 5 min.

Solusi:
1. Wait lebih lama (sometimes delayed)
2. Try again (re-request)
3. Call manager (urgent)
4. Escalate ke supervisor
5. If emergency: Contact IT support (override)

items.title: Q: Return rejected - How to proceed?
items.body:
A: Manager reject return request.

Komunikasi dengan customer:
1. Explain reason (per manager)
2. Offer alternatives:
   - Discount pada next purchase
   - Replacement item
   - Partial refund (compromise)
3. Escalate ke manager jika customer not satisfied

items.title: Q: Refund pending (card) - Customer asking when receive?
items.body:
A: CARD refund delayed (normal 1-5 days).

Customer komunikasi:
1. Explain: Refund processing dengan bank (1-5 days)
2. Provide: Reference # untuk customer track
3. Advice: Check account dalam 5 days
4. If not received: Follow up dengan bank
